subject: Re: FOI2026/23272 - 1988 Dispossession of Great House Farm, Llandough
source: Original email in the family's Gmail (read-only export); contact details redacted.
text:
Dear Army Secretariat,

Thank you for logging my request under FOI2026/23272 with a target date of 9 November 2026.

To assist your search, the following identifiers may be relevant: the taking of possession of Great House Farm / Tŷ Mawr, Llandough-juxta-Penarth on or about 29 November 1988; demolition commenced on or about 6 December 1988; any military or inter-agency liaison concerning the site at that time; and any records relating to William Beverly Buckler or Mary Doreen Williams in connection with the land.

I would also ask that any potentially relevant material be preserved pending the outcome of the request, in line with the preservation notices already issued to other bodies.

The public index is at https://greathousefarmwiki.wordpress.com, with the chronology index at https://dartboard.bucklerfamily.estate.

Regards,

Requester
